captions.detailed: This is a wall-mounted task lamp with a sleek, matte black finish. It features a rectangular wall bracket, a two-link swing arm connected by a central hinge, and a conical metal lamp shade at the end. The assembly is fully articulated: the first arm swings horizontally relative to the wall bracket, the second arm pivots at the elbow joint, and the shade tilts on a hinge at the tip.
captions.instruction: Generate a Python script using CadQuery to model a black wall-mounted task lamp. The model must feature a rectangular wall bracket, a two-segment articulated swing arm with realistic hinges, and a conical lamp shade, with revolute joints defined between each moving component to allow full swing and tilt movement.
captions.factory: The code constructs the lamp using an ArticulatedObject builder. The wall bracket is modeled using a Box primitive, while the arm segments are constructed using Box shapes with rounded hinge ends. The conical lamp shade is created using a hollowed-out cone or lofted cylinders. Each component (bracket, first arm, second arm, and lamp head) is defined as a separate Part, linked sequentially with revolute Articulation definitions to simulate realistic physical joints.
